context_requirements: Expression of at least one class I or class II HDAC target (ubiquitous in these lines)
Intact p53 pathway for robust CDKN1A induction and apoptosis (A375, MCF7, A549, HT29, HEPG2, HCC515)
Active MYC-driven transcription for rapid MYC downregulation and growth arrest
Proliferative capacity; quiescent or non-cycling cells respond weakly
falsifiers: No induction of CDKN1A at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
No decrease in MYC or proliferation-associated genes at 24 h
Strong and uniform upregulation of cholesterol biosynthesis genes (HMGCR, HMGCS1, FDFT1, EBP, NSDHL) at 6 h
Predominant interferon signature without CDKN1A or MYC changes
No difference between 6 h and 24 h responses (would suggest non-specific toxicity rather than HDAC inhibition)

evidence.supports: SAHA induces CDKN1A (p21WAF1) and decreases HDAC1 and MYC at the p21 promoter within 1 h
HDAC inhibitors are anti-cancer agents with growth arrest and apoptosis in cancer cells
HDAC inhibitor kinetics show histone acetylation changes that correlate with cellular effects
HDIs are anti-proliferative, causing cell-cycle arrest and apoptosis
HDAC inhibitor 4b ameliorates transcriptional abnormalities in HD models
